dog.label: 강아지
dog.query: (dogs[MeSH Terms] OR dog[Title/Abstract] OR dogs[Title/Abstract] OR canine[Title/Abstract]) AND (owner[Title/Abstract] OR owners[Title/Abstract] OR pet[Title/Abstract] OR companion[Title/Abstract] OR veterinary[Title/Abstract] OR clinic[Title/Abstract]) AND hasabstract

cat.label: 고양이
cat.query: (cats[MeSH Terms] OR feline[Title/Abstract] OR "domestic cat"[Title/Abstract] OR "domestic cats"[Title/Abstract] OR "pet cat"[Title/Abstract]) AND (owner[Title/Abstract] OR owners[Title/Abstract] OR pet[Title/Abstract] OR companion[Title/Abstract] OR veterinary[Title/Abstract] OR clinic[Title/Abstract]) AND hasabstract

petloss.label: 펫로스
petloss.query: ("pet loss"[Title/Abstract] OR "pet bereavement"[Title/Abstract] OR "pet grief"[Title/Abstract] OR "companion animal loss"[Title/Abstract] OR "companion animal death"[Title/Abstract] OR "death of a pet"[Title/Abstract] OR "loss of a pet"[Title/Abstract] OR "loss of a companion animal"[Title/Abstract]) AND hasabstract
